plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks destructive shell commands, asks before destructive git and settings edits, masks Bash reads of secret files, blocks the Read tool on them and asks before writes to them, blocks oversized whole-file Reads, and notes re-reads and retry loops.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Runs the /clear at the end of the guardrails handoff chain: once the handoff is written it clears the session and continues from it. Also warns as the context grows and blocks prompts past a limit. Needs the guardrails plugin and Claude Code 2.1.317 or newer.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code: indexes session transcripts into a local DuckDB, injects context at session start, and serves search tools over MCP. Fails open: a missing binary or a down daemon never blocks a session.

plugins.name: rtk
plugins.description: Tells Claude how rtk-condensed command output reads, and warns at session start when rtk is missing or is not the jj-scoll/rtk fork. It does not rewrite commands: turn on the guardrails rtk option for that. Needs the fork's rtk on PATH.
